why: Stage damage is set by the bracket, and the bracket by displayed power, so the stage preset is rolled for power ('순수 뻥투'), weapons and plates first. Crit resist and crit damage lines inflate power the most; DEF is treated as no option. When two pieces are within a few million, take the one with Skill AMP, Skill Haste or damage reduction. Since the easing, pushers past stage 300 rank power over Skill Haste over accuracy.

substats: Fill the stats the set lacks; don't stack accuracy/focus past the requirement
why: Gear power is weighted toward balanced stats: a duplicate stat adds little displayed power and a missing one adds a lot, so an accuracy/focus-heavy set lowers team power and can drop the bracket. Focus only matters once accuracy lands (a miss is a 0% debuff chance). One guide's split: accuracy/focus-heavy gear for a 35% attempt, combat gear with a little accuracy/focus at 55%.

Each stage has accuracy and focus requirements (accuracy tops out at 1,203.5). After the easing 900 accuracy is called enough to 328; ND러너 keeps about 1,000 past 300 and calls 1,300 wasted. Swap to an accuracy piece without hesitation when it also gives more power. Before the easing 35% pushers needed 1,000–1,100+.

substats: Skill AMP + crit rate (accuracy or focus if short)
why: Weapons: Skill AMP is the must-have line, then crit; stage enemies have no crit resistance, so one guide prefers crit rate over crit damage. Accuracy or focus goes here when the stage requirement isn't met.

Stage mobs don't crit, so crit resist does nothing in the fight (월린, 쿠키키키), but it inflates displayed power and so can lift the bracket (레벅's preset guide). Keep it only when the bracket line is what's missing.

substats: Skill AMP + Skill Haste (accuracy or focus if short)
why: Accessories carry Skill AMP and Skill Haste; about three Skill Haste lines across the set keeps the heal and buff rotation turning. One 240-30 GingerCraven clear needed 20+ Skill Haste from gear.

substats: Anything with the highest power (DR + HP when survival fails)
why: Armour is taken for power. When the front line dies (GingerCraven's burst before the easing), damage reduction and HP replace crit resist and evasion.

substats: A pure-power preset for the bracket line, a Skill Haste preset for auto
why: Two stage presets are common: an arena-like set (all Skill Haste lines) pushes smoothest on auto, and a 'power' set is equipped only when the team sits just under a bracket line. One commenter measured the arena set only about 200M below a stage set with two accuracy lines (crit resist inflates both); another couldn't reach 35% on the arena set. A 15% clear at 301-27 used a preset named 뻥투 (inflated power).
